runtime.note: A single native binary. The host needs no .NET runtime.

commands.name: kgsm
commands.why: reads each instance's schedule config through kgsm-lib

commands.name: python3
commands.why: deploy.sh's health probe opens the status socket, which bash cannot do
commands.without: the probe degrades to `systemctl is-active` and says so rather than claiming a stronger check

services.name: kgsm-watchdog.service
services.why: every scheduled restart is issued as IWatchdogClient.RestartAsync — the scheduler never stops a server itself
services.without: schedules are computed and every fire fails

system.why: fire times are wall-clock in each instance's IANA timezone
system.note: TimeZoneInfo reads /usr/share/zoneinfo directly; InvariantGlobalization=true does not break it.
